Plate 17's copings read as lines (measure.py) vote for walls bending back east at 20-30 degrees, 2.4 m high (4.9-6.5 px rms against 17.4-17.8 px for the straight line), but its panels grow towards the sheet's edges as if the walls came forward: the plate's perspective is constructed, the plan wins (Q312)

wall_pil.note: the walls' pilasters with sunk panels between: plate 17, eight a side between the gate and the sheet's edge

wall_urn.note: two urns on pedestals a side before the walls next to the gate, 1.4 and 2.55 m along the wall from its start at the gate: plate 17, x 688, 620 and 1715, 1787 (68-72 px apart, 1.1-1.2 m at the fitted camera)
